# Code Anchors: Close Over Several Pull Requests

- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/merge-gate.ts` — reads every story pull request's live merge state on its own, separate from the currency check, so an unmerged one can block without a waiver (#523)
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/merge-gate.spec.ts` — pins the per-story read, the unmerged list, and the unknown state when the platform call fails (#523)
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/exclusion.ts` — the write half of the storyless-story marker: the label the lead's waiver puts on the story issue, resolved through the shared publishing chain (#523)
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/exclusion.spec.ts` — pins the label write and its named failure (#523)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/range-list.ts` — one range entry per pull request, derived by calling the existing merge-anchored derivation once each, all-or-nothing, never merged or deduplicated per repository (#523)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/range-list.spec.ts` — pins the per-pull-request entries, the repeated-repository case, and the stop on the first unverifiable range (#523)
- `libs/workspace/src/canonical-remote.ts` — supplies the remote this close's trunk is resolved from, and the remote its stale-trunk remedy names (#628)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/trunk-check.ts` — verifies every stamped head is an ancestor of the trunk before anything is cut from it, short-circuiting on the first failure, and names the caller's own remote in the stale-trunk remedy (#628)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/trunk-check.spec.ts` — pins the ancestry check, the stale-trunk diagnostic naming the remedy, and the remote that remedy carries (#628)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the verb surface: the merge gate, the waiver write, the comma-separated pull-request list that keeps a bare number's output shape unchanged, and the canonical trunk resolved before the heads are verified against it (#628)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.spec.ts` — pins the singular output shape for one pull request and the plural shape for a list (#523)
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — the gate order, the storyless waiver and where its marker is written, the one-entry-per-pull-request stamp, and the one branch for the whole epic (#523)
